_about: RAMP InterActive sites (Website by RAMP InterActive; also tournamentsgurus.com tournaments). Game ids (GID) are global: /division/{cat}/{div}/game/view/{GID} opens the game on any RAMP host. Sources per entry: classic = the association's league games as JSON (https://www.owha.on.ca/api/leaguegame/get/{aid}/{sid}/0/0/0/0/, any classic RAMP host answers for any association); pages = Blazor schedule pages (division schedule or team masterschedule) read in a headless browser for the header's month, which also list tournament and exhibition games; discover = a tournament page whose menu lists the divisions and their teams, read without a browser, then only the divisions holding a header team are opened. comp: header competition words (lower case); teams: header team-name words that point at the entry; from/to: tournament dates (local).
